## What you'd like NetLens to do

(Be concrete. UI sketch, mock CLI flag, sample CSV column — whatever applies.)

## Why this fits NetLens

NetLens stays small on purpose. We're more likely to accept a feature that:

- Doesn't require admin rights, raw sockets or new external dependencies.
- Works in both GUI and CLI.
- Is deterministic (not "scan harder and see what falls out").

If your request needs one of those, please flag it — we may still help, but it might land as a separate sub-tool.

## Alternatives considered

(Did you find a workaround? Another tool that does it? Helps us understand the gap.)
